column1: # The platform's closed lists a spec is held to, one table for the course (Source/tests/testdata/platform_lists.tsv;
# spec.PLATFORM_HEARTBEAT_STRINGS, spec.SECRET_ROLES) and the product (testdata/platform_lists.tsv at its root;
# PlatformHeartbeatStrings, subsystemRoles + platformRoles in known.go), byte for byte. Owner: «Паритет». ADR-0019, its
# addition of 2026-10-10 (review 15 minor 15). A row is list, word; each list is a set — its order is not compared.
#   heartbeat_strings  the platform's own string fields of every heartbeat: a spec's heartbeat.strings names none of them
#   secret_roles       the roles secrets.readers may name
#   secret_readers     the platform's own secret rows and who reads them, <row or prefix>=<role> (`<row>=` — nobody but
#                      a spec that names a reader); ADR-0032, ADR-0066's addition of 2026-10-10 (the console reads the
#                      copy of the backup, to give it to a member that signs)
